gain_ray: a=1+lambda simultaneously scales local R/case, kappa, spatial gain, common modal gains relative to baseline uppers; other gains may independently lie below each upper.
baseline: Original local R/case uppers, nominal kappa upper, spatial multiplier 1, common modal gain uppers 1.25 times nominal.
certificate_family: Existing sufficient RF/temperature envelope with gain-dependent sharp quadratic universal common-history bound.
source_budget_definition: Integer prepaid command total-variation ticks including reserved return to zero; not joules or watts.
exact_capacity_method: At fixed gain: nine affine-in-source-budget full-matrix vertex solutions, max-affine power branches with nonnegative slopes; max branch capacities then min chip/profile/layout capacities; degree-1 upward RF rounding, no squared budget.
lookup_policy: Use ceil(10000*lambda) and its capacity; reverse lookup returns greatest certified grid gain meeting requested integer ticks. No smooth interpolation admission.
robust_definition: All four layouts and both heater profiles pass at each admitted grid envelope; dual10 dominates held10. Cmax+1 is rejected by at least one dual10 packet, not necessarily all packets.
raw_temperature_key_note: maximum_temperature_K in raw audit is temperature in degrees C on a 40 C baseline; temperature differences are K.
scope: Sufficient-certificate boundary within the stated gain ray, histories, source gate and thermal model; not global or physical maximal/Pareto frontier, hardware validation, time-varying-parameter or interval-ODE proof.
unbounded_tau_coverage: Analytic universal bound, not finite ODE sampling, supplies coverage for all allowed positive finite fixed common taus.
